key_interactions.effect: Lower lithium clearance; high risk of lithium toxicity (label).
key_interactions.action: Generally should not be given together.

key_interactions.effect: Reduce hydrochlorothiazide absorption by up to 85% and 43% (label).

key_interactions.action: Antidiabetic dose adjustment may be needed.
